chose: The transcriber's oldest arrival and count come from voice_repo::transcript::backlog, the queue's own predicate over every note waiting, read at a pass's start and after each attempt kept; never from the pass's batch.
options: a whole-queue read, true whatever order the pass hears in
the batch's first row, free but wrong once the batch is ordered fewest attempts first, and capped at 20
gray: Each read is the queue's own work; the pass makes at most one more read than attempts.
undo: Read once a pass, or take the batch's first row.
